label: lem:continuous_interval_integrable
title: Continuous functions are interval integrable
statement: If $f$ is continuous on $[\min(a,b), \max(a,b)]$, then $f$ is interval integrable on $[a,b]$. This is \texttt{ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable}.
proof: A continuous function on a compact interval is bounded and measurable, hence integrable.
